verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents open/click engagement tracking, bounce tracking, automatic complaint handling, analytics in its web interface, and an InboxReady inbox placement test using seed lists. A community user also notes Mailgun's analytics as an advantage over SES. There is no evidence of interpretive guidance or recommendations on sender reputation or placement beyond raw tracking, and complaint data is described as list hygiene rather than analytics. Missing for 10: documented complaint-rate analytics, sender-reputation scoring or monitoring, actionable deliverability guidance and recommendations, and hands-on corroboration of the inbox placement tooling.

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can see bounce, complaint, and engagement analytics with guidance on inbox placement and sender reputation, not just raw counts

citations.quote: Monitor who opens your emails and clicks on links, providing insights into recipient engagement.
Bounce Tracking | Identify and manage bounced emails to maintain a clean email list.
Manage your email campaigns, view analytics, and configure settings through an intuitive web interface.
A seed list is an object that provides the mailing list for your inbox placement test.
